source: Phase-2 parse-reply regression set (iter-32 parse-1 validation beats): full say-cycle documents distilled from six live agent-in-the-loop sessions over the mode-C door (s1 walkthrough seed 125; s2 the texture pin survives a failed take seed 42; s3 the texture promotion + canon birth seed 4; s4 the fire chain through the door seed 23; s5 the disambiguation family seed 8; s6 the malformed-probe family seed 41) - each replayed through the REAL session stack (Simulator + Mediator + ParserDoor over ONE shared SceneLedger, cli/parser.py + cli/mediator.py). The narrator half (texture establishment) runs through the real mediator beat; the player half through the say door; the two doors share the session's one ledger (D-049). Per PARSER_SPEC §6 the tally: 30 utterances, mix 21 intent / 6 question / 2 no_intent; 7/7 deliberate off-grammar probes caught loudly at the boundary (off-verb, ghost noun, non-integer ticks, off-enum method, two alternatives in one document, consumed texture reference, double apply); 21/21 boundary-accepted intent replies - 0 honest misfires, validity 100% among intent-alternative replies (questions and no-intent verdicts are honest outcomes, not violations); 3 door failures are world answers (take_failed, 2x intent_rejected), 1 door-law error after the pin (the one-path RunnerError, cycle pinned then refused). Session findings pinned per-cycle: the fire cascade drains INSIDE the door's own run_steps batch (drop_break cycle: 5 events, last location_burned_out - the iter-23 batch-boundary lesson through the say door); a PROMOTED texture entry is terminal - re-referencing it is off-grammar, the parser takes the disambiguation path (s6 cycle 3); a failed take keeps its entry live+pinned (s2, seed 42); a committed take IS the promotion (s3/s6, seeds 4/41 - canon birth loc_tavern.candles=lit); talk ripples 2 events (rumor_told). Provenance: worklog iter-32 + the runner (scripts/iter32_parse_runner.py, outside the repo) - the live logs and call/reply documents are gitignored runtime artifacts under the runner's scratch dir. The corpus's job: pin the phase-2 exit criterion's evidence (ROADMAP §2 - the ≥90% valid-intents gate review rides this volume; PARSER_SPEC §6 owns the measurement).
